page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. No marginal notes in text. A printed ornament (manicule-like hand mark) stands in the right margin beside the second line.

main_text.p: fuit,in pugna Saturninus Tri bunus pl.interfectus est.accu, satur[?]Rabirius perduellionis. Intentio:Perduellio es.D.Nō sum. Q.An sit? R. Quia perduellio est,qui sua sponte magistratum uiolat.at ego si uio laui, confulum imperio dustuque, quibus à me morem gestum oportuit, & omniū optimatum exemplo id feci. F.Imò perduellio est,qui sine populi iudicio ciuem R. ac multo magis magistratū sa-crofanctū interfecit: siue sua sponte, siue confulum imperio id fecit. D.Dicendus'ne perduellio sit is,qui Tribunū pl. sine populi quidem iudi-cio,

page.notes: Right margin: a printed hand/manicule ornament beside the second line, not text. Several words are uncertain: "satur[?]Rabirius" is read with the first word doubtful. Where the scan shows a long s, it is written as plain s. The word after "dustuque" is read as printed. The text is ornamented with some ligatures in "stuque" and "gestum", which are transcribed as printed. No catchword: the last line "cio," is a full line of text.
